Definition: Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Terah is the father of Abraham, and the head of the family that left Ur of the Chaldees for Canaan. In Genesis 11:24, Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah. The fuller story is told on the Terah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Terah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families. That is why I keep coming back to this name when I read the genealogy and the Gospels.
